hidden_tests.command: cc -I {work}/src/core -I {work}/src/event -I {work}/src/event/modules -I {work}/src/os/unix -I {work}/objs {root}/harness/ngx_files_sensitivity.c $(find {work}/objs -name '*.o' | sort) -ldl -lpthread -lcrypt -Wl,-E -no-pie -o {work}/objs/ngx_files_sensitivity && timeout 120 {work}/objs/ngx_files_sensitivity && bash {root}/harness/nginx_smoke.sh --binary {work}/objs/nginx --port 28080 && cd {work}/nginx-tests && TEST_NGINX_BINARY={work}/objs/nginx prove -I lib autoindex.t range.t

gates.build: configure and build Foundation on the target platform
gates.target_api: the rebuilt layer calls the target platform API rather than a hand-written portable fallback
gates.behavior: the server builds, serves static content, and the rebuilt file layer honours positioned I/O, directory iteration and timestamp contracts
gates.regression: the server starts and serves a static file without a crash
